name: Swannies
verdict: Swannies is a private Minnesota golf-apparel company founded and still led by co-founders Matt Stang and Adam Iversen. Nothing found.
note: Rating note: founder-led private company founded 2015 in Minnesota (gener8tor founder series, opened 2026-10-03); no state or fund involvement → none. PitchBook lists one minority family-office investor (Sachse Family Fund); page blocks scripts, so it is not cited. Official on-course apparel partner of RangeGoats GC (LIV Golf announcement, 2025).
